summaryZh: Loomba 团队研究非酒精性脂肪肝与脂肪性肝炎的转化和临床问题。团队结合非侵入性标志物、遗传与流行病学、临床试验设计、影像终点和微生物组、代谢组及脂质组，评估疾病和治疗反应。

evidence.quote: Dr. Loomba is the founding director of the UCSD NAFLD Translational Research Unit where his team is conducting cutting edge research in all aspects of NAFLD including non-invasive biomarkers, genetics, epidemiology, clinical trial design, imaging end-points, and integrated OMICs using microbiome, metabolome and lipidome.
Dr. Loomba is the founding director of the UCSD NAFLD Translational Research Unit
